setup/common: Do not start cni-dhcp before /opt/cni/bin/dhcp exists.
Retain SynthRAN host-safety and idempotence handling.
setup/netplan: Accept controller-selected netplan_config_file instead of reference-relative host files.
setup/pre_k8s: Own only the selected containerd storage binding before Kubernetes installation.
Bind a containerd subdirectory when the selected device is already mounted elsewhere; mount an unmounted device directly only when it is already ext4.
Never format storage implicitly and never pre-create kubeadm-generated kubelet configuration.
setup/k8s/k8s_setup: Consume SynthRAN's version-pinned Kubernetes baseline instead of the reference hardcoded package version.
Own Kubernetes packages only; deployment-only Python/Helm/yq tooling is owned by setup/deployment_runtime.
setup/deployment_runtime: Single checksum/version-pinned authority for the Ansible Kubernetes Python client, Helm, and yq used to execute downstream deployment roles.
Fresh bootstrap establishes this runtime before infrastructure roles that require it; preserve bootstrap never reaches it.
network.yml establishes or verifies the runtime after bootstrap so an accepted preserved cluster is not required to contain artifacts installed only by a prior SynthRAN fresh run.
setup/k8s/cluster_create: Consume the storage binding established by pre_k8s instead of unmounting/remounting it after kubeadm reset.
Patch kubeadm-generated kubelet configuration once, after kubeadm init.
Install checksum-pinned CNI plugins before cni-dhcp can start.
Create generated join material directly under the private execution tree at mode 0600 with no_log.
setup/k8s/cluster_join: Move admin and join material only through the private execution tree with restrictive permissions.
Do not recreate the stale on-disk kube-proxy config compatibility shim.
setup/k8s/cni_dhcp: SynthRAN-only ordering adapter: require executable /opt/cni/bin/dhcp before service installation/start.

caller_policy.fresh: May run host/runtime/storage/Kubernetes mutation roles after resource preparation and records shareable mount, CNI daemon and registered-node evidence.
caller_policy.preserve: Bootstrap is verification-only; it must not run reset, storage mutation, package/tool installation, cluster creation, join, taint, or tuning roles. Downstream deployment may establish execution-only tooling after this boundary without rebuilding the accepted host/Kubernetes state.
